visualCharacteristics: New variant (no existing variants in project): Full-bleed hero slider: cover photo per slide, large H1, intro and pill CTA, dot pagination | Full-bleed hero slider (3 slides: 'The value of active minds', 'Merlin', 'Income'). Each slide has a cover photo (absolute, object-fit cover) with white H1, intro text and a blue pill CTA; dot pagination top-left, labels visually hidden. The visual tree records #002755 as colored, but the section has a photo background, so the colour belongs to the hero block and the section is not styled.

contentPattern.reason: Interactive rotating slider of hero slides with a photo background per slide; Carousel rows are image | text.

usage: Full-bleed hero slider at the top of a landing page. One row per slide: background image | heading (H1 on the first slide), intro paragraph and one CTA link. Dot pagination; autoplays (paused on hover/focus and for reduced motion).
reuseGuidance: Use for rotating hero banners with a cover photo per slide. For a single static hero use the hero block; for compact text-led sliders use carousel-promo.
